items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: It’s either Poncho or a local conga player named Willie, a conga drummer named Willie Colon... I think it’s Willie Colon.

ctx.x: Okay. This, interesting story. I’m with Cal Tjader, right? Probably ’80 or thereabouts, ’81. And Carl Jefferson, who is Concord Records, calls and said, “I want you to do this, we’re going to do a record with a Brazilian piano player singer that I just signed and no one ever knew about it.” And I said, “Okay.” So he hired Cal’s — me, Cal’s drummer and bass player, Rob Fisher. And — is Poncho on that? Is Poncho on that do you know? I don’t have the liner note with me. It’s either Poncho or a local conga player…
